title: 較重的秤砣
subtitle: 一艘來自霹靂、吃水淺的沿岸小船運錫南下。首次起貨時，磅手對申報重量有疑問。您以沙班達爾身分登船，要在午後離港潮前查明。

evidence.label: 01  貨單
evidence.title: 阿魯斯號的申報
evidence.text:
阿魯斯號——來自霹靂的馬來沿岸小船
貨主：霹靂商人阿旺穆薩

錫錠，共七籃
申報淨重：7小巴哈
議定單價：每小巴哈140｜申報貨值：980

evidence.label: 02  秤錫
evidence.title: 同一批錫的兩個讀數
evidence.text:
七籃錫全放在甲板上，最底下一籃的外側有一層灰色硬皮。

重量：錫錠
磅手扣除籃子的通常重量。以小桿秤秤得8巴哈；沒有增減錫，移到大桿秤後讀數為7巴哈。

evidence.label: 03  問話
evidence.title: 當時用的是哪種秤？
evidence.text:
船長說，代理人早已在申報的錫貨一欄填了「小巴哈」。籃子從岸邊送來時，船長報了「七巴哈」；代理人沒上岸察看，便填上了七。

在霹靂操作秤的船夫說，小桿秤的鉤子當天早上裂了。他改用大桿秤，並在自己的秤量簿上記下「7——大」。他出示這筆記錄，寫在另外兩艘船的貨重之間。

evidence.label: 04  開箱驗貨
evidence.title: 籃子因何變重？
evidence.text:
開箱：沾有灰泥的籃子
搬運工取出錫錠。硬皮是籃外的乾泥；錫錠下沒有泥或壓艙物。他們再倒出其他籃內的錫，用小桿秤秤量裸錠，仍是8小巴哈。

rulings.label: 重大欺詐——扣留可疑貨物
特殊事件——扣船通報朝廷

reasons.label: 大桿秤讀數是七，申報無須更正。
籃外的泥解釋了多出的重量。
重量增加說明，有人在霹靂秤量之後偷偷添了錫。
霹靂用大桿秤；申報沿用其數字，卻寫成小巴哈。

feedback_by_method.marks: 籃外的灰色硬皮無法說明船夫在霹靂用了哪種桿秤。
feedback_by_method.contents: 取出錫錠可看出底下沒有壓艙物，但不能解釋霹靂的秤量簿為何寫七。
feedback_by_method.manifest: 申報寫七小巴哈，沒有說明船夫其實用的是大桿秤。

hidden_truth.success: 您以天猛公的名義將阿魯斯號的申報更正為8小巴哈、貨值1,120。七大巴哈是同一批錫，只用另一種秤量。霹靂的記錄和兩個讀數相符；錯在申報，而不在籃內。您准錫貨交易，並補徵1的磅費。
hidden_truth.clear: 您以天猛公的名義准阿魯斯號按申報放行。即使有八小巴哈進入市場，港務署仍按七小巴哈收磅費。
hidden_truth.unsupported: 所引用的證據不足以支持以天猛公名義作出的裁決。原申報不變，也不補徵磅費。
hidden_truth.hold: 您以天猛公的名義扣船並通報朝廷。朝廷的人發現兩種秤和一處申報錯誤。阿魯斯號失去了這筆交易。

truth.summary: The factor entered a large-dacing reading in the declaration’s small-bahar field without converting it.
truth.explanation: When the small dacing broke at Perak, the boatman used the large one and recorded its reading under the correct unit. The number, but not the unit, was relayed to the factor. Melaka’s two weighings independently reproduce both readings on the same load. The entire shipment was presented, and the bare tin alone accounts for all of its weight.
deduction: The manual says Melaka weighs tin by the small bahar. Seven large bahar balances eight small ones under the game’s conversion.
Both Melaka readings are for the same seven baskets. The large-dacing result reproduces the original Perak tally exactly; the small-dacing result is one small bahar above the declaration.

The broken hook and the nakhoda’s account of how he relayed the number explain why the declaration used the wrong unit. The conversion accounts for the entire discrepancy, without any missing baskets or later loading.
Weighing the bare slabs confirms that the crust is not responsible. Correct the weight and value rather than detaining the cargo for fraud: Minor Fault.

red_herrings.why_not_guilt: The crust is surface mud on the basket. The bare tin has the same net weight.

clean.text: You clear the tin as declared and understate the weight by one small bahar.

minor_fault.text: In the temenggung’s name, you correct the declaration to eight small bahar and clear the tin for trade.

major_fraud.text: You mistake two readings of the same load for concealment. The weighing tally does not support a fraud charge.

story_event.text: You hold the Arus for the court. Its men find a weight-unit error, not a matter of state, and the sale is lost.

history_notes.note: The western Malay Peninsula supplied tin, including from Perak (Pires, Suma Oriental, vol. II). Small coastal craft carried tin to Melaka.
Nunes (Livro dos Pesos da India, 1554, fol. 31) describes Melaka’s small bahar for tin and large bahar for goods such as pepper. Both had 200 kati, but their kati differed in mass.
The player is a shahbandar and rules in the temenggung’s name. Port-wide authority over berthing and inspection is a gameplay abstraction.

Seven large bahar to eight small is a rounded ratio treated as exact in play, not a historical conversion. The manifest and the boatman’s written tally are invented for the game. The boat, people and incident are fictional.
